name: day _ of _
what_it_is: Day _ of _ means "It's day _ of my ongoing attempt at _." Creators use it for serial, diary-style logs of a numbered daily attempt at a personal goal; tone is usually casual. The blanks take a day count and the activity, as in "Day 6 of learning everything I know about meme coins."
why_it_popped: videos get 4.4x their creators' follower count in views
